messages:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — marketplace partner ACME asked about SDK compatibility for our upcoming auth header change. They want a guaranteed graceful fallback window (90 days). Anyone available to own gating and comms?
Ben Chu: I'm on. Do we have a migration flag or plan?
Jorge Alvarez: We don't have a persistent runtime flag for partners today. We can add a 'Compat-Mode' header that maps old auth -> new signer server-side behind a feature flag.
Nina Schmidt: That will impact signer rotation. Security/legal previously approved 60-day windows, partner asking for 90. Need signoff.
Ian Cole: Infra note: extending the rotation window is doable but we must add telemetry to detect legacy header usage. Also will need a short canary to validate perf impact.
Maya Patel: Proposed playbook: 1) Deploy compat-mode FF scoped to partner(s); 2) Canary 5% -> 20% progression; 3) Marketplace announcement with 90-day deprecation runway; 4) Telemetry dashboard + weekly partner report; 5) Optional short-term grace proxy if needed.
Ben Chu: +1. Add a revocation step in runbook if we detect misuse. Who owns the legal wording? @Nina? :white_check_mark: 
Jorge Alvarez: Canary details: start 5% for 24h. If P95 latency delta < 15ms and error delta < 0.5%, bump to 20% for 72h. If stable, open to partner.
Nina Schmidt: I'll prep the legal-safe wording. Will loop in marketplace PM. Draft comms needed ASAP.
Ben Chu: Draft comm (private link): <https://goblin/redwood/drafts/acme-compat>. Snippet: 
```
Subject: Important: SDK Auth header update and compatibility path
We will deprecate X-Redwood-Auth v1 on 2026-06-01. To avoid service disruption, update to X-Redwood-Auth v2 or enable the Compat-Mode header. We offer a 90-day compat grace period for approved partners.
```
Ian Cole: Ops toggles (initial runbook):
- Run: `/deploy toggle-feature compat_mode --env=prod --partner=acme`
- Monitor: `metric.partner.compat_usage` and `metric.partner.latency_delta`
- If `compat_usage > 0.05` after deprecation -> alert and open incident review
Ben Chu: SDK impact: we can ship client-side shim in SDK v3.1.2 that auto-adds the Compat-Mode header if old auth detected. Recommend coordinating SDK release with marketplace announcement.
Jorge Alvarez: Also flag downstream integrators (SI teams) — they may need staggered release windows. Recommend a joint release calendar slot.
Nina Schmidt: Proposed timeline: Announce Monday -> FF deploy Wed (canary 5%) -> Telemetry 2 weeks -> Full 90-day grace period -> Deprecation notice final on day 90.
Ben Chu: I'll schedule a sync with marketplace ops and partner success to lock announcement slot. :thumbsup: 
deploy-bot: Canary rollout completed for `compat_mode` -> 5% for acme. CI trace: deploy/cc/3112224400. No errors in first 2h.
Maya Patel: Great — thanks. Action items: Ben schedule partner ops sync; Nina draft legal text + marketplace PM; Jorge and Ian run canary dashboard; I'll own partner comm and announce cadence.
Maya Patel: One more ask — should we offer a short-lived proxy certificate for partners who can't update quickly? Pros/cons?
Ian Cole: Proxy cert possible but operationally heavy. If we do it, limit to 30 days and strict telemetry. Prefer server-side compat flag + SDK patch.
Ben Chu: Agreed. Proxy as last resort with SRE approval.
Maya Patel: Ok team — I'll circulate a one-page runbook and timeline after this thread. Thanks everyone! :pray:
